name: @bedlamlabs/dixie
description: DOM-level CLI browser for AI agents. Render pages, query elements, run tests, capture network activity — all without a real browser.

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:lib
scripts.build:cli: esbuild bin/dixie.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/dixie.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:lib: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:esbuild --external:js-yaml --external:tsx --outfile=dist/dixie-lib.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
